author: bdanzi
body:
As per title, the PR aligns the offline phase-2 mkFit+LST JSON (`mkfit-phase2-lstStep-offline.json`) to the HLT phase-2 mkFit JSON (`mkfit-phase2-lstStep.json`, modified and merged in #21) with the changes of:
- duplicate cleaner changed to _phase2:clean_duplicates_sharedhits_pixelpriority_ptadaptive_ (introduced in https://github.com/cms-sw/cmssw/pull/51847);
- backward-fit outlier rejection: hits with a chi2 increment above 20 are dropped from the backward fit (at most 3 per track, only for tracks with pT > 5 GeV) - `m_backward_fit_outlier_chi2 = 20, m_backward_fit_max_outliers = 3, m_backward_fit_outlier_min_pt = 5 GeV`;
- direction-only duplicate is checked off (dc_drth_central/obarrel/forward = 0). 
- The seed cleaning handling stays as in the offline JSON, since the seeding between offline and HLT currently is different (`m_seed_cleaner_name phase1:default, maxCandsPerSeed 3, m_requires_seed_hit_sorting = true`).

## Physics Validation
- Full offline tracking performance: [QCD Pt1800-2400](http://uaf-3.t2.ucsd.edu/~bdanzi/Phase2Offline/PRTests_52011_52015_JetCore_20261008/qcd/18_cmsdata23_allIters), [ttbar PU200](http://uaf-3.t2.ucsd.edu/~bdanzi/Phase2Offline/PRTests_52011_52015_JetCore_20261008/ttbar/18_cmsdata23_allIters)
- First two tracking iterations performance:  [QCD Pt1800-2400](http://uaf-3.t2.ucsd.edu/~bdanzi/Phase2Offline/PRTests_52011_52015_JetCore_20261008/qcd/18_cmsdata23_Iters01) , [ttbar PU200](http://uaf-3.t2.ucsd.edu/~bdanzi/Phase2Offline/PRTests_52011_52015_JetCore_20261008/ttbar/18_cmsdata23_Iters01)
Curves in plots: `LST_IB`: LST+mkFit offline tracking default in `CMSSW_20_1_X_2026-10-27-2300` + cms-sw/cmssw#51847, `LST_newJSON`: LST+mkFit offline tracking default in `CMSSW_20_1_X_2026-10-27-2300` + cms-sw/cmssw#51847  + this PR

**Physics summary**:
**Efficiency**:  with the first two tracking iterations (`trackingIters01`), the new JSON keeps the candidates in jet cores that the current duplicate cleaning removes. The efficiency in QCD increases with pT > 0.9 GeV.  In TTbar the efficiency is essentially unchanged: the gain is specific to dense environments.
**Fake rate**. Essentially unchanged inclusively. It decreases at high pT (pT > 10 GeV). 
**Duplicate rate**. It increases only slightly inclusively and stays within a few percent with `Iters01`:
With all iterations the duplicate rate is higher (up to 8% at pT > 100 GeV in QCD), partly because the LST tracks are not cross-cleaned against the other offline tracking iterations; a separate cmssw PR addresses this and reduces it by about 20%.
title: Use the pT-adaptive pixel-priority duplicate cleaner in the Phase-2 Offline mkFit JSON
